text_block_list.text:
It happened when Epiphaneia asked me to 
watch her dance practice—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, yeah, that won't do.
choice_data_list: Why? You were dancing perfectly fi...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it. Right now, this place 
is missing something vital!
choice_data_list: Why? You were dancing really well,...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Without someone you want to captivate
and a stage worthy of showcasing it,
no matter 
how skilled you are, it won't be a dance 
that moves hearts!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So, let's go, Trainer! To the stage where 
I belong!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: That's just how my heart leads me!

text_block_list.name: Stylish Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Aweeeesome! Razor-sharp moves, and 
outstanding emotional expression!
That was 
groovy as hell!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, the house is packed 
with a discerning audience! Very well, 
allow me to captivate every single one of 
you!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Audience Member
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! That's nifty! I used to tear up 
the streets back in my youth, too, but at 
my age...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Age has nothing to do with dancing! When 
your heart catches fire, you dance—that's 
all there is to it! Come on, Grandpa, 
let's dance!

text_block_list.name: Beach Audience
text_block_list.text:
"Not bad, Umamusume missy! How about 
dancing on our ship next time?
The sea god 
would be thrilled!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
With pleasure! I'll fire up the gods 
themselves and aim for a bountiful catch!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was a good sweat! So, how was 
it? My dance, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that right! If you dance with 
passion in your heart, it will truly move 
the hearts of those who watch!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone's passionate cheers
and 
the greatest stage, I danced my absolute 
best! It felt amazing! However—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My dancing can go even higher. Realizing 
that potential makes me happier than 
anything!
choice_data_list: So we're changing locations and da...
Are we changing locations and danc...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's not bad either, but if you're 
aiming for the top, you should challenge 
yourself with something harder!
choice_data_list: Are you moving somewhere else to d...
Are you changing spots to dance again?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
For example—challenging an Umamusume who 
has something I don't to a dance battle! 
Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what kind of opponent do you think I 
should take on?
choice_data_list: Let's try dancing with someone who...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds great! If we combine skill and 
passion with unique individuality, it'll 
turn into an incredible dance!"
choice_data_list: Try dancing with someone whose ind...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, you're having a dance battle 
with me! You're more than worthy of being 
my opponent!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho, ho, ho, you have fine eyes. Clear 
eyes, just like a horseshoe crab's.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! Where are the horseshoe crab's 
eyes? More importantly,
let's have a dance 
battle—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Follow me. I shall show you a swamp 
teeming with crayfish. Though whether 
artist's conk makes for good bait or bad 
is a matter of much debate.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
All right, you got it! If I catch more, 
you're gonna have a dance battle with me!

In the end, a dance battle with Gold Ship 
was not meant to be, but for some reason, 
a bizarre new quirk began to show itself.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see! Strength is also a major draw that 
captivates people! Someone I could learn 
that from would be—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Gentil! I challenge you to a dance-off!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, my... Hoho.
I suppose this is the duty 
of the strong. However—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's just dancing, since you're 
challenging me, I trust you've prepared 
yourself accordingly?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
When it comes to learning about 
raw power, there couldn't possibly be a 
better choice than you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"And since I'm taking on the challenge, 
I'm definitely taking the win! Let's see 
what you've got!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I see.
It doesn't seem like they're just a 
reckless challenger running on momentum 
alone. How interesting.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we be on our way? To the 
stage where we can battle to our hearts' 
content. I expect great things from you, 
Epi-san.

Having experienced Gentildonna's power 
firsthand,
Epiphaneia's dancing took on an 
overwhelming strength that would
captivate all who watched.
